targets.query:
from(bucket: "iot_data")
  |> range(start: 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z, stop: now())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "node_status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "boot_count" or r._field == "uptime_s")
  |> group(columns: ["device_id", "_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["device_id", "_field", "_value"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["device_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
